The Tzanck smear is likely to show multinucleated giant cells, confirming a herpes virus etiology. The combination of grouped vesicles on an erythematous base and subsequent mucosal ulceration is classic for HSV. Have you noticed any history of cold sores or genital herpes prior to this episode?
